meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个闪电图标,绿点表示运行中、红点表示已停止,点击后可启动、停止、重启服务或查看日志。仅限 macOS。
howto.when: 用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器时触发,例如输入 /add-macos-statusbar。仅支持 macOS 系统。

howto.what_en: Adds a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw: a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether the service is running, plus Start, Stop, Restart, and View Logs controls. macOS only.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw (e.g. by invoking /add-macos-statusbar). macOS only.
